Quinn","description":"Using an RTL-SDR, detect the 21cm hydrogen line from the Milky Way. A LNA is mandatory for results. Instructions below

Step 1: Calibration
Aim reciever away from the plane of the Milky Way. Choose the centre frequency and integration time for background measurement and press Start Calibration. Integration time does not reflect actual elapsed time, and may take twice as long as expected.

Step 2: Scanning:
Select a time from which to scan the sky. They plot will show a moving average, depending on the time selected.

Step 3: Accumulation:
After pressing accumulate, the plot will reset, and all future measurements will contribute towards the plot. Use once you hae confirmed the Milky Way is the target.

Plot settings:
Smoothing - Using the Savitzy-Golay filter, smooth the plot. Applies while in scanning and accumulation mode. Adjust the filter frame length and polynomial order.

Plot Hydrogen Line - a red line is displayed where the hydrogen line should be, to obsereve red/blue shift.

Saving figures: All figures are saved as [filename][time].png. Example: User sets the filename to 'figure' at 3:15pm, the file will be saved as 'figure1515.png'

Hardware Check: Allows the app to continue running should the RTL-SDR become disconnected.
